# Drop Coverage

> Drop Coverage publishes NBA player predictions for every game, set against the bookmaker lines, with a public record of what covered.

Drop Coverage (thedropcoverage.com) projects every NBA player and game each night: a prediction for points, rebounds, assists, threes and the combined markets, with the range the result lands inside 80% of the time, set against the bookmakers' player prop lines in decimal odds. Game trends give every team's record against the spread and over/under by situation and date range, and each team's game log. Times are Australian eastern time (AEDT/AEST). The Drop is the one player prop each night we rate most likely to cover at a price that still pays (60%+ to cover and 5+ points above the bookmaker's fair chance, after our chance is pulled halfway to the market's), chosen by the model, never by a person, staked at 1 unit and graded on closing-line value. Accuracy is published openly: average error by market and how often results land inside the ranges.

Key terms: "edge" is our probability minus the bookmaker's probability with its margin removed. "CLV" (closing-line value) is the price we posted against the bookmaker's fair price at tip-off. COVERED / NOT COVERED is used only for graded results (The Drop and the graded props), never for every projection; every projection's accuracy is published separately. Projections are data, not a promise of profit. 18+. Gamble responsibly: Gambling Help Online, 1800 858 858 (Australia); 21+, 1-800-GAMBLER (US).

## Pages

- [NBA predictions today](https://thedropcoverage.com/predictions.html): every player tonight, the bookmaker line and how often he has cleared it in his last five and ten games; members see the prediction, probability and edge
- [The Drop](https://thedropcoverage.com/tip.html): the player prop we rate most likely to cover tonight, on the record, with every Drop since, its closing-line value and its units
- [NBA game trends](https://thedropcoverage.com/games.html): against the spread and over/under by situation and date range, with tonight's games and the bookmaker lines
- [NBA tips today](https://thedropcoverage.com/nba/tips-today/): today's games with the bookmaker lines and The Drop, linking each game's page
- [Game pages](https://thedropcoverage.com/nba/games/): one page per game, dated, with the win chance, injuries, rest, form, trends and the key players' last five games; the result is added after the game
- [Team pages](https://thedropcoverage.com/teams/): each team's game log with the line, cover, total and over/under, and with or without any player
- [Player props and stats](https://thedropcoverage.com/players/): every player's predictions, season averages and recent games
- [Track record](https://thedropcoverage.com/track-record.html): how accurate the predictions are
- [NBA games today in Australian time](https://thedropcoverage.com/schedule.html)

## Data

- [Open data](https://thedropcoverage.com/api.html): the JSON files behind the site, with every field described
- [Tonight's players and lines (JSON)](https://thedropcoverage.com/data/projections.json): the free columns; the full predictions are the members' data described on the open data page
- [Tonight's games (JSON)](https://thedropcoverage.com/data/games.json): win chance and the bookmakers' lines
- [The Drop record (JSON)](https://thedropcoverage.com/data/tips.json)
- [Track record (JSON)](https://thedropcoverage.com/data/track_record.json)
